text:
sam (sre): noticed a short spike of TLS handshake_failure for cross-region requests (us-west -> eu-west) at ~02:15 UTC. creating thread to track follow-ups.

alert-bot: alert: high_tls_errors on /v1/chat  02:16 UTC  p95=780ms incident_id=inc-20260326-04

maya (networking): quick triage: I see ephemeral port reuse patterns in netflow and a few NAT churn events overlapping the window. I'll grab tcpdumps from egress gateways.

rob (eng-runtime): stack traces show TLS alert 40 (handshake_failure) and occasional "certificate unknown" where SNI is present. attaching sample logs to the ticket.

sam (sre): action T1: collect 15m tcpdump on egress-us-west-1 (port 443) and upload filtered pcap. owner: maya (networking). ETA: 2026-03-26 03:00 UTC.

rob (eng-runtime): action T2 (mitigation): enable 500ms transient backoff for cross-region retries and enable short session stickiness for 6h to reduce mid-handshake rehome. owner: rob. ETA: 2026-03-26 02:30 UTC.

maya (networking): action T3: run cert-roll audit for eu region to check for partial rollout windows that could cause SNI -> wrong-cert hits. owner: maya. ETA: 2026-03-27 00:00 UTC.

cloud-eng: opening provider case for NAT port usage and AS-path traces (CASE-8350). owner: cloud-eng. ETA: 2026-03-29 18:00 UTC.

sam (sre): scheduled sync 2026-03-26 08:00 UTC to review pcaps and provider reply. marking this thread as the canonical follow-up for the incident. please drop artifacts here. :thumbsup:

alert-bot: incident state -> mitigated (2026-03-26 02:45 UTC)
